provider: Viber Business Messages / REST Bot API

free_tier.stated: No storage quota — same inversion as Kakao: you pass a picture URL, Viber fetches it. Max image 1 MB on iOS, 3 MB on Android, thumbnail 100 KB.

egress.terms: N/A — Viber hosts nothing for you. It requires 'The URL must have a resource with a .jpeg, .png or .gif file extension as the last path segment', i.e. it is a consumer of your public URLs.

tooling: viber-bot-python / raw REST POST to https://chatapi.viber.com/pa/send_message. Sender-only API.
chaining: Not chainable. No upload, no media_id, no listing, no retention — structurally incapable of storing a byte.
limits_note: 1 MB (iOS) / 3 MB (Android) image cap applies to the file YOU host; Viber rejects larger. Business messaging also requires partner onboarding for phone-number-based sends.
reliability_note: N/A for storage. Recorded only so the next agent does not re-investigate: Viber is a URL consumer, never a URL producer.

evidence.proved: read live: 'media | URL of the image (JPEG, PNG, non-animated GIF) | required. The URL must have a resource with a .jpeg, .png or .gif file extension as the last path segment ... Max image size: 1MB on iOS, 3MB on Android.'
